facts.text: Andrew plans to take pictures during his trip to a nature reserve.

evidence.quote: This weekend I'm heading to a nature reserve to reconnect with the outdoors - excited!
Don't forget to take some nice pictures!
Sure thing, I'll get some awesome pics to show you when I return.
